Kishau Multipurpose Project Agreement Signed After 8-Year Delay

An agreement for the Kishau Multipurpose Project was signed after an eight-year delay, resolving a water dispute. The pact was signed in the presence of Union Home Minister Amit Shah. Chief Ministers of six North Indian states were present at the signing. The project is expected to enhance Delhi's long-term water security.
